title: Hippo, Billy's death and Tony's risque songs
summary: After Billy died the risque songs fell to Tony; Williams discusses the catch lines and the worst song Tony sang.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: They call him Hippo. Hippo. He didn't work that long. He died. He died. He died. He died. They come to me. After Billy died, they come to me. I had to do the risque songs. I never heard the risque songs sing.

Well, that was the tone risque we used. There was never enough for a letter of words. It wasn't Tony's song. It was the catch line and something like that. The worst song ever Tony sang, I believe, was... What? Indian Man? Well, that was...
